verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring automation is a fair question for a terminal with deep scripting, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no built-in recurring scheduler. Triggers are event-driven regex matches rather than time-based schedules, AutoLaunch.scpt is a one-off run at startup rather than a recurring schedule, and the Python and AppleScript APIs are developer building blocks a user could wire to an external scheduler, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
